reason: The README clearly presents the plugin as persistent cross-session memory and context infrastructure for agents, with SQLite storage, recall and search tools, session-event ingestion, knowledge evolution, and an MCP bridge.

summaries.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供基于本地 SQLite 的跨会话持久记忆、上下文召回、知识整理和 MCP 工具接入。
summaries.en: Provides AI agents with local SQLite-backed cross-session memory, context recall, knowledge processing, and MCP tool integration.

capabilities: persists agent memories in a local SQLite database
reads session events and can automatically store user messages
exposes memory recall, search, timeline, reflection, learning, and reasoning tools
runs a local Python MCP subprocess with automatic restart behavior
supports ingesting text, files, URLs, and web search through configured tools
